Here's a rephrased version of your writing:

"The trade replay issue is causing the reporting of 'REPL' instead of 'NEWM' to TRAX on our active trades. This issue is due to the fact that the trades are not being archived in CMRS, which is a result of the RH archiving story 2323911. This issue is impacting the implementation of the #13 fix changes.

The new ESP extract for #13 is sending replay messages of rebooked trades, which are updated with the original Position Trader information based on the OMS trade linkages. Since these are all replay messages (<SST_REPLAY> = 'Y'), RH will report them as 'REPL' to TRAX.

The #13 replay messages will all be rejected by TRAX, as they have never been reported to TRAX before. In summary, the #13 replayed trade messages will be treated like other BAU replay messages, all of which get rejected. This means that the #13 changes from ESP and RH are essentially useless."

The rephrased version aims to improve the clarity and flow of the text, while maintaining the key points and information you provided.
